title: Student Verification Lapse at Unlimited Student Annual Renewal
content:
**Student programme rule — renewal of Unlimited Student Annual (Marlowe & Finch Unlimited)**

A student verification lasts 12 calendar months. A student membership whose verification has lapsed by its renewal date, and was not renewed within 14 calendar days after the lapse, renews into Unlimited Standard Annual at that plan's list fee; it is never cancelled for the lapse alone. Non-student plans ignore this rule.

The membership record shows, for Unlimited Student Annual, the last day of the student verification; the verification has lapsed once that day has passed.

| Verification lapsed by the renewal date | Re-verified within 14 calendar days after the lapse | Outcome at renewal |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Renews into Unlimited Standard Annual at that plan's list fee |

In every case, the lapse of a student verification on its own never cancels the membership.

**Hypothetical case.** An Unlimited Student Annual membership renews on 1 September. Its verification ran through 31 May and lapsed on 1 June, and the member did not re-verify in the 14 calendar days after the lapse. At the 1 September renewal the membership renews into Unlimited Standard Annual and is charged that plan's list fee; it is not cancelled.

**Hypothetical case.** An Unlimited Express Annual member has no student verification on record; the plan is not a student plan, and this rule does not touch its renewal.
